scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/contracts build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/domain build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/database build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/model-gateway build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/application build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/task-engine build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/worker build
scripts.build:app: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && find dist -name '*.map' -delete && find dist -name '*.test.*' -delete && rm -rf dist/worker && cp -r ../worker/dist ./dist/worker
scripts.package: pnpm build && electron-packager . --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=out --overwrite --name='AI 小说创作代理' --executable-name=ai-novel-generator --no-prune --ignore='src/' --ignore='scripts/' --ignore='\.(map)$'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
